title: TOEIC – Kiểm tra kho lạnh
prompt:
Write exactly ONE complete sentence about the picture using BOTH given words or phrases. You may change their grammatical forms. (pallet / check)

Yêu cầu: Nêu thao tác kiểm kê và vị trí của thùng hàng.
image_description: Inside a refrigerated produce warehouse, a worker wearing a thermal jacket checks an inventory sheet beside a wooden pallet stacked with sealed crates of oranges. Frost is visible on the far wall.
sample_answer: The worker is checking an inventory sheet beside a pallet of oranges.
tips_md: **TOEIC Writing – Picture:** Dùng *is checking* cho thao tác đang diễn ra; đặt *beside a pallet* để xác định vị trí. Hai từ gợi ý phải xuất hiện rõ trong một câu.

sample_answer: The potter is shaping a clay bowl while an assistant cleans the table.
tips_md: **TOEIC Writing – Picture:** Với *while*, viết hai mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và động từ riêng. Dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn cho công việc đang được quan sát.

title: TOEIC – Lên phà qua cầu dẫn

title: TOEIC – Bổ sung phụ đề hội nghị

Read the email and write a reply of at least 60 words. Address all three questions.

From: Olivia Brooks, Events Coordinator
Subject: Captions for Friday's industry panel

We are finalizing Friday's online panel. Can your team enable live English captions? Please confirm whether the recorded session will also have captions, and tell me when we can test the attendee view.

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận phụ đề trực tiếp, phụ đề bản ghi và thời gian kiểm thử giao diện.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Brooks,

Thank you for checking the accessibility arrangements. Our streaming platform supports live English captions, and I have enabled this feature for Friday's panel. We will also add corrected captions to the recording before it is shared with participants on Monday.

I suggest testing the attendee view on Thursday at 3 p.m. I can send you a private test link and stay online to check caption timing and readability. Please let me know if you would prefer an earlier session.

Best regards,
Ethan Park
tips_md: **TOEIC Email:** Trả lời đủ ba nội dung theo đúng thứ tự. Phân biệt *live captions* với phụ đề bản ghi được chỉnh sửa sau sự kiện. Gợi ý một lịch thử cụ thể và kết thư lịch sự.

title: TOEIC – Mượn bộ chuyển tín hiệu

The new laptop only has a USB-C port, but Room B's projector uses HDMI. Do you have a suitable adapter? Could you check the projector before Monday, and explain whom the instructor should contact if the connection fails?

Yêu cầu: Trả lời về bộ chuyển đổi, lịch kiểm tra và đầu mối hỗ trợ kỹ thuật.

Dear Daniel,

We have two USB-C-to-HDMI adapters available in the IT cabinet, so I will reserve one for Monday's workshop and keep the other as a backup. I can test the laptop and projector in Room B at 4 p.m. on Friday.

If the connection fails during the session, the instructor should call the internal IT help desk at extension 214. A technician will be on duty throughout the morning. I will also leave a short connection guide beside the projector.

Kind regards,
Hannah Le
tips_md: **TOEIC Email:** Dùng *reserve an adapter*, *test the connection* và *contact the help desk* để trả lời chính xác. Đặt lịch kiểm tra trước ngày diễn ra sự kiện.

Yêu cầu: Nhận hoặc từ chối nhiệm vụ hướng dẫn, nêu hai hoạt động, liệt kê vật dụng cần thiết.

Noah Pham

title: TOEIC – Giờ làm việc tập trung
prompt:
Some offices introduce two hours each morning when employees avoid nonessential meetings and notifications. Do you think this is a good policy? Give reasons and examples. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu quan điểm rõ, cân nhắc lợi ích năng suất và khả năng phối hợp giữa các nhóm.
sample_answer:
A daily period without unnecessary interruptions can be an effective policy for many offices. I support this idea because it allows employees to complete demanding tasks, although the schedule should remain flexible for urgent work.

The main practical benefit is better concentration for everyone. Preparing financial forecasts, reviewing complex documents and fixing software defects all require sustained attention. When staff members must respond to messages every few minutes, they spend additional time remembering where they stopped. Two protected hours can help them finish important work earlier and with fewer mistakes.

A second advantage is that meetings become more purposeful. If colleagues know that routine discussions should take place after the focus period, they may organize questions in advance and invite only people whose input is necessary. This saves time for everyone.

However, the policy must allow exceptions. A customer service representative cannot ignore a critical outage just because the team has entered focus time. Managers should therefore identify emergency communication channels and let teams choose hours that fit their responsibilities.

Overall, I believe protected focus time is a sensible practice when organizations combine it with clear exceptions and respect for different roles. It helps employees work deeply without sacrificing essential cooperation.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion:** Câu mở thể hiện lập trường đồng ý có điều kiện. Hai đoạn thân bài nêu lợi ích riêng, sau đó thêm trường hợp ngoại lệ. Dùng *sustained attention*, *routine discussions*, *emergency channels* phù hợp văn phong công sở.

title: TOEIC – Trợ cấp phương tiện công cộng
prompt:
A company can provide either free parking or monthly public transport passes as an employee benefit. Which option should it prioritize? Explain your choice with examples. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: Chọn một chính sách ưu tiên và giải thích tác động đến nhân viên cùng doanh nghiệp.
sample_answer:
If a company must choose between free parking and public transport passes, I would prioritize the passes. Although parking benefits some employees, transport support can offer broader practical and environmental advantages in a city with reliable bus and rail services.

First, monthly passes can substantially reduce everyday commuting expenses for staff who do not own cars. New employees and younger workers may otherwise spend a considerable share of their salaries on daily travel. A pass is also predictable because it covers regular journeys without requiring employees to calculate individual fares.

Second, encouraging public transport can reduce pressure on limited parking spaces. For example, if twenty employees switch from driving to the train, the company may avoid renting additional parking spaces. The money saved could support other staff benefits or improve the workplace.

I recognize that public transport is not equally convenient for everyone. Employees on late shifts or those living far from established routes may still need to drive. The company could offer limited parking support where a clear accessibility or scheduling need exists.

In my view, transport passes should be the standard benefit, with carefully defined exceptions. This approach supports more employees while helping the organization manage costs and congestion.
tips_md: **TOEIC Choice Essay:** Giữ nhất quán lựa chọn *public transport passes*. Nêu đối tượng hưởng lợi, chi phí và ngoại lệ hợp lý. Tránh khẳng định phương tiện công cộng phù hợp mọi người.

title: TOEIC – Đào tạo hội nhập trực tuyến
prompt:
Some employers deliver all new-hire orientation through recorded online modules. Others prefer face-to-face sessions. Which approach is more effective for new employees? Support your opinion with specific reasons. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: So sánh hai hình thức và đưa ví dụ về công việc thực tế.
sample_answer:
For new employees, especially those entering unfamiliar roles, I believe face-to-face orientation is generally more effective than relying entirely on recorded modules. Online materials are convenient, but early personal contact helps people understand both their responsibilities and the workplace culture.

During an in-person session, new hires can ask questions immediately. A trainer might demonstrate how to report a safety problem or submit an expense request and then check whether everyone understands the procedure. Recorded videos cannot easily identify confusion or adapt an explanation to a particular role.

In-person orientation also introduces employees to colleagues across departments. These early relationships matter when someone later needs help with a customer issue or a technical problem. Meeting a support contact once can make it much easier to ask for assistance during the first month.

Online modules still have an important role. Employees can revisit short videos about company policies, and remote staff may need flexible schedules. A practical solution is to provide essential information online before the first day, followed by interactive workshops and introductions.

Therefore, I would make face-to-face interaction the center of the onboarding process while using recorded resources for preparation and review. This combination supports both confidence and long-term learning.
tips_md: **TOEIC Comparison:** Chỉ rõ tiêu chí *asking questions* và *building relationships*. Đoạn phản biện thừa nhận vai trò học liệu trực tuyến. Kết luận lặp lại hình thức đã chọn.

title: TOEIC – Hóa đơn điện tử cho khách hàng
prompt:
Retail stores increasingly offer digital receipts instead of printed ones. Should companies make digital receipts the default option? Give reasons and examples. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: Đưa quan điểm về tiện ích, chi phí và khách hàng có khả năng tiếp cận công nghệ khác nhau.
sample_answer:
I believe retail stores should offer digital receipts by default, provided that customers can easily request a printed copy. A digital system can simplify record keeping and reduce paper use, but it should remain accessible to people with different preferences.

One important benefit is convenience. Customers who receive receipts by email can search for a purchase when returning a product or checking a warranty. Paper slips are easy to lose, especially when someone shops at several stores during the same week. Digital records can also help small businesses manage returns more efficiently.

Another significant advantage is the reduction of unnecessary paper waste. A busy store may print hundreds of receipts daily, many of which are discarded immediately. Offering an electronic option could lower paper purchases and decrease the amount of material thrown away.

Nevertheless, employees should ask permission before collecting an email address or telephone number. Some customers do not use smartphones, while others prefer not to share personal contact information. For those shoppers, printed receipts should remain available without an extra fee.

To conclude, digital receipts can be a sensible default because they improve convenience and reduce waste. Their success, however, depends on clear privacy choices and an equally simple paper alternative.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion:** Tách lợi ích *record keeping* và *reducing waste*. Đưa điều kiện về bảo mật và lựa chọn hóa đơn giấy. Tránh dùng khẳng định tuyệt đối.

title: TOEIC – Thời hạn trả lời phản hồi khách hàng
prompt:
A service company wants every customer comment, including suggestions rather than complaints, to receive a response within one working day. Is this a good use of staff time? Explain your opinion with practical examples. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: Đánh giá lợi ích chăm sóc khách hàng và cách ưu tiên nguồn lực hợp lý.
sample_answer:
Responding quickly to customer comments can strengthen a company's reputation, but a fixed one-day deadline for every message may waste staff time. I would support prompt acknowledgement while allowing different response periods for different kinds of feedback.

Customers appreciate knowing that someone has read their concerns. For example, a person who reports a failed payment should receive an acknowledgement immediately and an explanation of the next steps. Such communication can prevent frustration and repeated messages to the support team.

However, not every comment requires a detailed individual answer within one day. A suggestion about future product colors can be recorded and reviewed during a weekly planning meeting. Requiring a long reply to every small idea may distract employees from urgent cases that affect customers right now.

The company could therefore adopt a simple priority system. Employees would acknowledge all messages within one working day, resolve critical problems as quickly as possible and provide considered responses to nonurgent suggestions after review. Managers could track outstanding cases to prevent them from being forgotten.

In conclusion, speed matters, but useful and accurate responses matter more. A flexible policy would demonstrate respect for customers while giving staff enough time to address the most pressing issues.
tips_md: **TOEIC Evaluation:** Phân biệt *acknowledge* (xác nhận đã nhận) với *resolve* (giải quyết). Đưa cơ chế ưu tiên và ví dụ rõ cho phản hồi khẩn cấp cùng góp ý dài hạn.

title: TOEIC – Buổi chia sẻ kỹ năng nội bộ
prompt:
An organization is considering a 30-minute weekly session where employees teach colleagues a useful work skill. Do the benefits outweigh the possible disadvantages? Explain with examples. Write about 200–250 words.

Yêu cầu: Đánh giá lợi ích và chi phí thời gian của hoạt động chia sẻ kỹ năng.
sample_answer:
A weekly skill-sharing session can be a valuable investment for an organization. Although it takes time away from routine duties, I believe its advantages are greater when participation is planned carefully.

The most obvious benefit is that employees learn practical methods from people who understand their workplace. A finance assistant, for instance, might demonstrate a spreadsheet shortcut that saves colleagues several minutes each day. Staff members can immediately ask questions and adapt the technique to their own tasks.

These sessions can also improve cooperation between teams. When employees explain their work, colleagues begin to understand the constraints they face. A short presentation by the customer support department may help product designers recognize the questions users ask most often.

The main disadvantage is scheduling. A weekly meeting could interrupt critical deadlines, especially for teams dealing with customers in real time. To limit this problem, managers should rotate presenters, record sessions and allow employees with urgent responsibilities to watch later. Topics should be chosen according to real needs rather than simply filling a calendar.

In my opinion, thirty well-organized minutes a week can produce lasting benefits in efficiency and understanding. With flexible attendance and useful topics, the program is likely to be worth the time invested.
tips_md: **TOEIC Advantages–Disadvantages:** Đưa phán đoán *outweigh* ngay ở mở bài. Mỗi lợi ích cần ví dụ nghề nghiệp. Nêu cách giảm bất lợi về lịch làm việc.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Tỷ lệ đi làm bằng xe đạp
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The original line chart below compares the percentage of commuters who travelled to work by bicycle in three districts of one city. The figures are given as data points in Markdown.

| District | 2018 | 2021 | 2024 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Riverside | 12% | 17% | 23% |
| Hillview | 8% | 13% | 21% |
| Old Town | 4% | 6% | 11% |

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. Do not speculate about reasons for the trends.

Yêu cầu: Mô tả xu hướng tăng của ba khu vực và so sánh khoảng cách đầu kỳ với cuối kỳ.
sample_answer:
The line chart compares the proportions of people commuting by bicycle in Riverside, Hillview and Old Town in 2018, 2021 and 2024.

Overall, cycling became more common in all three districts throughout the period shown. Riverside had the highest share in every year, while Old Town consistently had the lowest. Hillview experienced the largest increase in percentage points.

In 2018, 12% of Riverside commuters travelled by bicycle, compared with 8% in Hillview and only 4% in Old Town. By 2021, these figures had risen to 17%, 13% and 6%, respectively. At that point, Riverside remained four percentage points ahead of Hillview, and the difference between Hillview and Old Town had widened to seven points.

The upward trend continued in the final three years. By 2024, bicycle commuting accounted for 23% of journeys to work in Riverside and 21% in Hillview, leaving a gap of just two percentage points. The figure for Old Town reached 11%. Across the whole period, Hillview gained 13 percentage points, compared with increases of 11 points in Riverside and seven in Old Town.
tips_md: **IELTS Academic Task 1:** Mở bài diễn đạt lại đề, viết *overview* chỉ ra xu hướng chung và nhóm cao/thấp. Dùng *percentage points* khi so sánh 8% lên 21% (tăng 13 điểm phần trăm), không viết tăng 13%. Không giải thích nguyên nhân thiếu số liệu.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Lượt mượn sách theo thể loại
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The table gives the number of books borrowed (in thousands of loans) from a regional library in two years. This is an original dataset.

| Genre | 2019 (thousand loans) | 2023 (thousand loans) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Fiction | 48 | 62 |
| Children's books | 35 | 40 |
| History | 18 | 14 |
| Technology | 9 | 19 |

Summarise the main features and make relevant comparisons in at least 150 words. Include an overview and avoid explanations unsupported by the table.

Yêu cầu: So sánh quy mô các thể loại và xác định nhóm tăng nhanh nhất về tỷ lệ.
sample_answer:
The table presents the number of library loans for four book genres in 2019 and 2023, measured in thousands.

Overall, fiction remained the most frequently borrowed category, whereas history was the only genre to experience a decline. Total borrowing rose during the period, with technology books recording the strongest proportional growth.

In 2019, the library recorded 48,000 fiction loans, comfortably ahead of children's books at 35,000. History accounted for 18,000 loans, and technology ranked last with just 9,000. Together, the four categories generated 110,000 loans that year.

By 2023, fiction borrowing had increased to 62,000, a gain of 14,000. Loans of children's books rose more modestly by 5,000 to reach 40,000. Technology more than doubled from 9,000 to 19,000 loans, moving above history in the ranking. In contrast, history fell by 4,000 to 14,000, becoming the least borrowed genre in the final year.

Overall loans across the categories reached 135,000 in 2023, which was 25,000 more than in 2019. Fiction contributed the largest absolute gain, while technology showed the greatest relative increase.
tips_md: **IELTS Academic Task 1:** Phân biệt tăng tuyệt đối (fiction tăng 14 nghìn) và tăng tương đối (technology tăng hơn gấp đôi). Tổng 2019 = 110 nghìn, 2023 = 135 nghìn. Nêu một nhóm giảm làm điểm đối lập.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Cơ cấu sử dụng nước sinh hoạt
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. Two original pie charts show how household water use was divided among four activities in City A and City B in 2025. Their proportions are provided in Markdown.

| Activity | City A | City B |
|---|---:|---:|
| Laundry | 35% | 28% |
| Cooking and drinking | 12% | 14% |
| Bathing | 30% | 38% |
| Gardening | 23% | 20% |
| **Total** | **100%** | **100%** |

Describe the key features and differences. Write at least 150 words. Treat the percentages as shares of total residential water consumption.

Yêu cầu: Nêu mục sử dụng lớn nhất tại mỗi thành phố và đối chiếu chênh lệch theo điểm phần trăm.
sample_answer:
The two pie charts compare the proportions of household water used for laundry, cooking and drinking, bathing, and gardening in two cities in 2025.

Overall, laundry was the largest category in City A, while bathing accounted for the greatest share in City B. Cooking and drinking used the smallest proportion of water in both locations. The distribution in City B was more heavily weighted towards bathing.

In City A, laundry represented 35% of domestic water use, followed by bathing at 30%. Gardening accounted for a further 23%, leaving 12% for cooking and drinking. Together, laundry and bathing made up almost two thirds of consumption, at 65%.

The ranking was different in City B. Bathing took the largest share, at 38%, which was eight percentage points higher than in City A. Laundry used 28% of the total, seven points less than the figure for City A. Gardening was slightly less prominent in City B, at 20%, compared with 23% in City A.

Cooking and drinking represented 14% in City B, just two percentage points above the corresponding share in City A. Thus, the most striking contrast was between the cities' allocations to bathing and laundry.
tips_md: **IELTS Pie Charts:** Mỗi thành phố cộng đúng 100%. Ưu tiên *accounted for*, *represented*, *percentage points*. Tránh suy diễn mức tiêu thụ bằng lít vì bảng chỉ có tỷ trọng.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Lượng khách tại ba nhà ga
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The original line graph reports average daily passengers at three train stations from 2019 to 2023. Figures are in thousands and are transcribed below.

| Station | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Central | 70 | 75 | 39 | 58 | 81 |
| North | 40 | 42 | 25 | 35 | 46 |
| East | 25 | 29 | 20 | 26 | 36 |

Summarise the main trends and make comparisons. Write at least 150 words. Do not assume a cause for the sudden fall.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích giai đoạn tăng, giảm mạnh năm 2021 và phục hồi về cuối kỳ.
sample_answer:
The line graph illustrates changes in average daily passenger numbers at Central, North and East stations between 2019 and 2023, with figures expressed in thousands.

Overall, Central handled considerably more passengers than either of the other stations throughout the period. All three sites experienced a substantial decline in 2021, followed by a recovery that brought passenger numbers to their highest levels in 2023.

In 2019, Central recorded an average of 70,000 passengers per day. The corresponding figures were 40,000 at North and 25,000 at East. Each station saw a small increase in 2020, reaching 75,000, 42,000 and 29,000 passengers, respectively.

However, the figures fell sharply in 2021. Central's daily total dropped to 39,000, a reduction of 36,000 from the previous year. North fell to 25,000, while East declined to 20,000. All three stations then recovered in 2022, although their figures remained below the levels observed in 2020.

By 2023, Central had climbed to 81,000 passengers a day. North reached 46,000, and East stood at 36,000, exceeding each station's earlier peak.
tips_md: **IELTS Line Graph:** Chỉ mô tả biến động quan sát được, nhất là điểm trũng 2021. Số liệu tính theo *thousand passengers per day*. Không tự gán nguyên nhân dịch bệnh khi biểu đồ không cung cấp.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Cơ cấu nguồn điện
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The original pair of stacked bar charts shows the percentage of electricity supplied by five sources in a region in 2022 and 2025. The chart labels are presented below.

| Electricity source | 2022 | 2025 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Solar | 15% | 28% |
| Wind | 10% | 18% |
| Hydropower | 25% | 22% |
| Natural gas | 35% | 23% |
| Coal | 15% | 9% |
| **Total** | **100%** | **100%** |

Summarise the main features and compare the shares. Write at least 150 words. Do not assume total generation changed.

Yêu cầu: So sánh tỷ trọng nguồn tái tạo và nhiên liệu hóa thạch, dùng đơn vị điểm phần trăm.
sample_answer:
The two stacked bar charts compare the shares of electricity provided by five energy sources in a region in 2022 and 2025.

Overall, renewable sources accounted for a substantially larger proportion of the electricity mix in 2025. Solar power made the biggest gain, while natural gas and coal both lost share. Natural gas was the leading individual source at the start, but solar became the largest by the end.

In 2022, natural gas supplied 35% of electricity. Hydropower contributed 25%, while solar and coal each accounted for 15%. Wind had the smallest share, at 10%. The three renewable sources together made up exactly half of the total.

By 2025, solar had risen by 13 percentage points to 28%, overtaking every other source. Wind increased by eight points to 18%, although hydropower slipped from 25% to 22%. These changes lifted the combined renewable share to 68%.

Meanwhile, natural gas fell by 12 points to 23%, and coal dropped from 15% to 9%. Consequently, fossil fuels represented 32% of the electricity mix in 2025, compared with 50% three years earlier.
tips_md: **IELTS Task 1 – Stacked Bars:** Mỗi cột cộng 100%. Nhóm tái tạo = solar + wind + hydropower, tăng từ 50% lên 68%. Dùng *share* và *percentage points*, tránh đoán sản lượng điện tuyệt đối.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Tốc độ giao bưu kiện theo loại hàng
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. An original 100% stacked column chart compares delivery times for three categories of parcels in 2024. Each row represents all deliveries in that category.

| Parcel category | Within 1 day | 2–3 days | 4 or more days |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Documents | 72% | 23% | 5% |
| Clothing | 48% | 41% | 11% |
| Appliances | 18% | 52% | 30% |

Summarise the information and make relevant comparisons in at least 150 words.

Yêu cầu: Chỉ ra loại hàng nhanh nhất, chậm nhất và khoảng thời gian phổ biến nhất cho từng nhóm.
sample_answer:
The stacked column chart compares how long deliveries took for documents, clothing and household appliances in 2024. The figures are expressed as percentages of deliveries within each product category.

Overall, documents were delivered the fastest, while appliances were the most likely to take four days or longer. The two-to-three-day period was the most common delivery window for appliances, whereas same-day or next-day service dominated document shipments.

For documents, 72% of deliveries arrived within a day. A further 23% took between two and three days, and only 5% required at least four days. This was the smallest long-delay share among the three categories.

Clothing showed a more even distribution. Nearly half of clothing deliveries, at 48%, arrived within one day, compared with 41% in the two-to-three-day band. The remaining 11% took four or more days.

Appliances displayed the opposite pattern from documents. Only 18% arrived within a day, while a majority of 52% were delivered in two or three days. Another 30% took at least four days, six times the corresponding proportion for documents. Thus, delivery times varied markedly by parcel category.
tips_md: **IELTS Task 1 – 100% Stacked Columns:** Tổng mỗi loại hàng phải bằng 100%. Chú ý *within one day*, *two to three days* và *four or more days*. So sánh sáu lần chính xác 30%/5% = 6.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Giờ tình nguyện của hai trường
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The original grouped bar chart shows total student volunteering hours at two schools during three years.

| School | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| School A (hours) | 210 | 260 | 325 |
| School B (hours) | 240 | 235 | 300 |

Summarise the main changes and compare the schools in at least 150 words.

Yêu cầu: Mô tả trường dẫn đầu ở mỗi năm và thay đổi của chênh lệch giữa hai trường.
sample_answer:
The grouped bar chart presents the total number of hours that students at Schools A and B spent volunteering between 2022 and 2024.

Overall, both schools recorded more volunteer hours at the end of the period than at the beginning. School B led in the first year, but School A overtook it in 2023 and maintained a small advantage in 2024. School A also showed steady growth throughout the three years.

In 2022, students at School B completed 240 volunteer hours, compared with 210 hours at School A. This meant that School B held a lead of 30 hours. The pattern changed the following year, when School A increased its total to 260 hours. School B, in contrast, fell slightly to 235 hours, giving School A a 25-hour advantage.

In 2024, both schools achieved their highest totals in the period shown. School A reached 325 hours, a rise of 65 hours from 2023. School B also added 65 hours to finish at 300. As a result, the gap between the two schools remained at 25 hours.

Across the full period, School A added 115 hours, while School B gained 60 hours.
tips_md: **IELTS Task 1 – Grouped Bars:** So sánh chênh lệch 2022 (B hơn 30 giờ) và 2023–2024 (A hơn 25 giờ). Mức tăng 2023–2024 của cả hai trường đều 65 giờ. Tránh nhầm giờ tình nguyện với số học sinh.

title: IELTS Task 1 – Khách tham quan địa điểm ven biển
prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1. The original line chart shows visitor numbers, in thousands, at three coastal attractions in four selected months of 2025.

| Attraction | January | April | July | October |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lighthouse | 8 | 12 | 20 | 10 |
| Aquarium | 15 | 18 | 25 | 21 |
| Wetlands | 6 | 9 | 14 | 7 |

Summarise the key patterns and make comparisons. Write at least 150 words. The months shown are selected observations rather than continuous monthly totals.

Yêu cầu: So sánh thứ hạng ba điểm tham quan và đỉnh lượng khách tháng Bảy.
sample_answer:
The line chart compares the number of visitors to a lighthouse, an aquarium and a wetlands reserve in four selected months of 2025. Figures are given in thousands.

Overall, the aquarium attracted the most visitors in every month shown, while the wetlands reserve remained the least visited. All three destinations reached their highest recorded figures in July, followed by declines in October.

In January, the aquarium welcomed 15,000 visitors, almost twice the lighthouse's 8,000. The wetlands reserve had the lowest figure, at 6,000. Numbers increased at all three sites by April, reaching 18,000 at the aquarium, 12,000 at the lighthouse and 9,000 at the wetlands.

The upward trend continued to July. Aquarium attendance peaked at 25,000, a gain of 10,000 compared with January. The lighthouse also recorded a substantial rise, attracting 20,000 visitors, while the wetlands reserve reached 14,000.

By October, the aquarium's figure had fallen to 21,000, which was still higher than its January level. Attendance at the lighthouse halved from its July peak to 10,000, and the wetlands reserve declined to 7,000. The aquarium therefore retained a clear lead despite the late-year falls.
tips_md: **IELTS Line Chart:** Đọc đúng đơn vị *thousands of visitors*. Nhấn mạnh tháng Bảy là đỉnh chung. Bốn tháng là điểm quan sát riêng nên tránh khẳng định điều gì diễn ra trong các tháng không hiển thị.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Thông báo công trực tuyến
prompt:
In some cities, public agencies are replacing printed notices with information published only through websites and mobile applications. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this change? Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích hai mặt, đưa ra đánh giá mức độ lợi ích và sử dụng ví dụ dịch vụ công hợp lý.
sample_answer:
Publishing public information online offers governments a faster and potentially less expensive way to communicate with residents. However, using digital channels exclusively could exclude people who have limited internet access. I believe the advantages are substantial, but they outweigh the drawbacks only when alternative forms of access remain available.

One major benefit is speed. A city can update a website immediately when a road closes or a public service changes its opening hours. Printed posters may take days to replace, especially across a large area. Digital notices can also include maps, translations and links to application forms. Residents may therefore find the information they need without visiting an office.

Another advantage is reduced administrative work. Officials do not have to print and distribute every minor update, and corrections can be made centrally. Over time, this may free staff to concentrate on more complex requests from the public.

Nevertheless, a digital-only system creates serious difficulties for some residents. Older people, individuals with disabilities and those who cannot afford reliable internet service may struggle to access important announcements. A person who does not see an online notice about a water supply interruption could miss the chance to prepare. Digital messages can also be difficult to distinguish from fraudulent imitations.

The strongest approach is to publish updates online while retaining essential information on noticeboards and through staffed telephone lines. Agencies should make websites accessible and provide clear guidance about official sources.

In conclusion, digital publication improves speed and efficiency, yet exclusive reliance on it risks unfair access. With reliable offline channels for critical announcements, its benefits can clearly exceed its disadvantages.
tips_md: **IELTS Task 2 – Advantages/Disadvantages + Opinion:** Trả lời cả hai phần, nêu hai lợi ích và một rủi ro cụ thể rồi chốt điều kiện để lợi ích vượt trội. Dùng *digital-only*, *administrative work*, *accessible channels* chính xác.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Cộng đồng sửa chữa đồ dùng
prompt:
Many electronic products are replaced rather than repaired. Some people argue that local governments should fund community repair centres, while others say repairing products is a private responsibility. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Trình bày lập luận của cả hai phía và nêu quan điểm kèm mô hình triển khai có thể thực hiện.
sample_answer:
The growing tendency to discard damaged electronics has prompted proposals for publicly funded repair centres. Some people believe these centres would benefit entire communities, whereas others argue that owners should pay for their own repairs. In my view, local governments can reasonably support small repair programmes, provided they focus on education and waste reduction rather than subsidising every individual purchase.

Supporters of public funding point to the environmental costs of discarded devices. Even a relatively simple fault can cause a household to replace a printer or kitchen appliance because professional repairs appear inconvenient. A community workshop could teach residents how to diagnose basic problems, replace safe components and maintain equipment. Reusing an item for another year may reduce waste and the demand for new materials. Such workshops could also provide useful technical skills to young people.

Opponents have a different concern. Council budgets are limited, and residents may reasonably prefer spending on roads, libraries or essential care services. Moreover, not all appliances can be repaired safely by volunteers. If a centre repeatedly fixes privately owned luxury devices at public expense, the programme may offer little benefit to taxpayers who never use it.

A balanced policy would address these concerns. Municipalities could provide a modest venue and fund safety training, while users contribute towards replacement parts. Qualified technicians should handle electrical hazards, and the programme should publish the amount of waste diverted from disposal. These measures would make the benefit more visible and the cost easier to control.

Overall, responsibility for maintaining belongings should remain with owners, but targeted community support can make safe repairs more accessible and help reduce unnecessary disposal.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Dành một đoạn cho lập luận về lợi ích môi trường, một đoạn cho chi phí công, và một đoạn quan điểm dung hòa. Không xem tất cả thiết bị đều có thể tự sửa an toàn.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Miễn phí bảo tàng cho cư dân
prompt:
Some people think publicly funded museums should offer free admission to local residents, while charging tourists an entrance fee. Others believe everyone should pay the same price. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Tranh luận về công bằng, ngân sách hoạt động và tính tiếp cận văn hóa.
sample_answer:
Museums preserve cultural collections and make them available for education. Whether residents and tourists should pay different admission fees is a question of both fairness and funding. I believe free or reduced admission for local residents can be justified in publicly funded museums, although pricing policies should remain transparent.

Those who support resident discounts argue that local taxpayers already help finance museums through public budgets. Charging them again may discourage frequent visits, particularly among families with limited incomes. Free entry can enable children to return for school projects, attend temporary exhibitions and become familiar with local history. These repeated visits may create greater educational value than a single visit.

On the other hand, a uniform price appears simpler and more equitable. Tourists can contribute to the local economy in many ways, and some may have incomes lower than those of residents. A higher charge based solely on home address could feel unfair. Museums also have real expenses, including conservation work, security and specialist staff. If admission revenue declines substantially, the quality of exhibitions may suffer.

In my opinion, the best arrangement depends on a museum's funding. A publicly supported museum could provide free general admission to residents and a moderate fee for visitors, while offering discounts based on age or financial need to everyone. Additional charges for special exhibitions could help support conservation. Clear signs should explain how revenue is used and why particular discounts exist.

To conclude, equal pricing is administratively straightforward, but local access has educational value that public funding is intended to promote. A carefully designed resident scheme can advance that purpose without placing an unreasonable burden on visitors.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Đối chiếu *tax-funded access* và *equal treatment*. Kết luận thể hiện ý kiến cá nhân, đưa cách thu phí minh bạch thay vì chỉ lặp lại ý hai phía.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Hoạt động thương mại về đêm
prompt:
Many cities encourage restaurants, shops and cultural venues to stay open late to create jobs and attract visitors. What problems might this cause for local residents, and what measures could reduce those problems? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết dạng Problems–Solutions; liên kết mỗi vấn đề với biện pháp khắc phục tương ứng.
sample_answer:
Extending the opening hours of restaurants, shops and cultural venues can bring economic activity to city centres after dark. However, a busy night-time economy may also reduce the quality of life of nearby residents. The main difficulties are noise, transport disruption and pressure on public spaces, all of which can be managed through careful local policies.

Noise is often the most immediate problem. Music, delivery vehicles and crowds leaving venues late at night can disturb people who need to sleep before work or school. When several businesses operate on the same street, the combined effect may be much greater than the noise produced by any individual venue. Councils could respond by setting reasonable outdoor noise limits, restricting late-night loading and requiring venues to keep doors closed during performances. Enforcement should be consistent, with clear procedures for residents to report persistent problems.

A second issue is transport and street safety. Large numbers of customers may leave at similar times, increasing demand for taxis and causing congestion near residential buildings. Litter and poorly lit walking routes can also make streets less pleasant. Cities could introduce designated pickup areas away from apartment entrances, extend selected public transport services on busy evenings and provide additional waste collection. Better lighting and visible staff would help people travel safely without creating unnecessary disturbance.

Businesses themselves should contribute to these solutions. For example, restaurants could coordinate delivery schedules and share responsibility for cleaning nearby pavements. Residents should be consulted before operating hours change so that practical concerns can be addressed.

In conclusion, late-opening businesses can provide jobs and entertainment, but their success should be measured alongside residents' well-being. Reasonable rules and coordinated transport services can allow economic activity to continue without making neighbourhoods difficult places to live.
tips_md: **IELTS Problems–Solutions:** Mỗi giải pháp phải xử lý đúng vấn đề đã nêu. Dùng *noise limits*, *designated pickup areas*, *waste collection* và tránh giả định tất cả khu dân cư đều chịu cùng một mức ảnh hưởng.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Kiểm chứng thông tin trong trường học
prompt:
Some educators argue that evaluating online information should become a compulsory subject in secondary schools. Others think existing subjects can teach these skills without adding a separate course. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: So sánh môn học độc lập với việc tích hợp kỹ năng vào các môn hiện hành, kèm ví dụ dạy học.
sample_answer:
The ability to assess information found online has become increasingly important for students. Some educators propose a compulsory subject devoted to this skill, while others would include it in lessons that schools already teach. I favour integration across subjects, supported by a small number of dedicated workshops.

A separate course would give information literacy a clear place in the timetable. Students could learn how to check the author of a website, compare sources and identify misleading statistics. With a specialist teacher, schools could assess progress through practical activities rather than assuming that young people acquire these abilities naturally. A structured course might also ensure that every student receives a basic foundation.

Nevertheless, adding another compulsory subject could place pressure on already crowded timetables. More importantly, evaluating evidence is not limited to one academic field. A history lesson can teach pupils to compare accounts of an event, while a science lesson can examine whether a claim is supported by experimental data. Even a mathematics class can show how a graph's scale changes the impression created by numbers. Applying the same skill in different contexts helps students see when it matters.

In my view, schools should establish shared learning outcomes and then assign practical exercises to several departments. Teachers would need training and common assessment criteria, so integration would be deliberate rather than occasional. Short workshops could cover specialist topics such as manipulated images, advertisements and personal data.

In conclusion, a standalone course would offer structure, but the wider curriculum provides more opportunities for repeated practice. Teaching source evaluation throughout school subjects is likely to make students more confident and careful users of information.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Tập trung hai giải pháp tổ chức chương trình học. Cho ví dụ trong lịch sử, khoa học và toán; ý kiến cuối phải làm rõ vì sao chọn tích hợp.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Tuần làm việc bốn ngày
prompt:
Some organisations are experimenting with a four-day working week without reducing employees' pay. To what extent do you agree or disagree that this should become a standard practice across most industries? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu mức độ đồng ý rõ ràng, phân tích năng suất và hạn chế theo ngành nghề.
sample_answer:
A four-day working week with unchanged pay is an attractive idea for employees who want more time outside work. I agree that it should be offered more widely where practical, but I do not think it can immediately become the standard arrangement across most industries.

In office-based roles, a shorter week may encourage teams to use their time more efficiently. Workers could reduce unnecessary meetings, plan tasks more carefully and spend longer periods on focused work. Additional rest may also improve morale and reduce the exhaustion that can lead to errors. For example, a design team with clear project deadlines might deliver the same amount of work by simplifying its approval process rather than extending the hours of each working day.

However, many services depend on a fixed amount of staff coverage. Hospitals, public transport operators and restaurants need employees during the hours when people use them. Reducing everyone's working days without hiring extra personnel could result in long queues, cancelled appointments or excessive pressure on staff who remain on duty. Smaller employers may find the additional recruitment costs difficult to absorb.

There is also an important distinction between fewer working days and fewer working hours. Compressing forty hours into four very long days might increase fatigue, especially for employees with demanding commutes or caring responsibilities. Any trial should therefore assess productivity, customer experience and employee well-being separately.

I would support voluntary pilots and flexible scheduling rather than an immediate universal rule. Governments and industry groups could share results from carefully monitored trials, allowing employers to adapt successful approaches.

In conclusion, a paid four-day week may improve some workplaces, but its suitability varies considerably. Gradual adoption based on evidence is more realistic than making it compulsory for nearly every sector.
tips_md: **IELTS Agree/Disagree:** Lập trường *partly agree* nhất quán. Phân biệt tuần bốn ngày với việc dồn 40 giờ làm vào bốn ngày. Ví dụ ngành dịch vụ giúp nêu giới hạn thực tế.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Bao bì của dịch vụ giao đồ ăn
prompt:
Food delivery services often use disposable containers and bags. Who should be primarily responsible for reducing this waste: delivery companies, restaurants or customers? Give reasons for your answer and consider the roles of the other groups. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Chỉ định nhóm chịu trách nhiệm chính, đồng thời phân tích hợp tác giữa ba bên.
sample_answer:
The popularity of food delivery has increased the amount of disposable packaging used for takeaway meals. Reducing this waste requires action from customers, restaurants and delivery platforms. In my view, delivery companies should take the leading role because they can coordinate changes across many businesses and influence purchasing decisions at scale.

Platforms control important parts of the ordering experience. For instance, an application can make disposable cutlery optional rather than adding it to every order automatically. It can also display which restaurants offer reusable or lower-waste packaging and explain any return arrangements. Because customers use the same interface to order from numerous restaurants, one design change could influence a large number of purchases.

Delivery companies can also help restaurants overcome practical obstacles. A small café may be unable to negotiate competitive prices for better containers or organise a system for collecting reusable packaging. A platform could work with suppliers to provide affordable options and establish shared collection points. Such coordination is particularly important when orders travel long distances and containers must remain safe and leak-resistant.

Restaurants still have direct responsibility for choosing suitable packaging and avoiding unnecessary layers. They should test containers to ensure that meals arrive in good condition. Customers, meanwhile, can decline extra utensils, separate recyclable material correctly and choose lower-waste options when they are available. These decisions matter, but individuals often have limited choices if the app offers none.

Overall, the responsibility is shared, yet delivery platforms are best placed to lead systemic improvements. By changing default options and supporting restaurants, they can make less wasteful behaviour practical for customers rather than relying only on individual goodwill.
tips_md: **IELTS Opinion with Multiple Stakeholders:** Trả lời câu *primarily responsible* bằng một nhóm cụ thể. Nhắc vai trò hai nhóm còn lại nhưng dành phần phân tích sâu nhất cho lựa chọn chính.

title: IELTS Task 2 – Thiết kế thư viện công cộng
prompt:
Public libraries are increasingly adding group study rooms, workshops and community events. Some people worry that this change reduces the quiet space available for reading. Should libraries prioritise traditional silent areas or collaborative activities? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Đánh giá nhu cầu yên tĩnh và tương tác, đề xuất cách tổ chức không gian có căn cứ.
sample_answer:
Public libraries have traditionally offered quiet places where people can read and study. Many now host group discussions, practical workshops and community activities. I believe libraries should protect substantial silent areas while providing carefully managed spaces for collaboration, because both functions serve important public needs.

Quiet reading rooms remain valuable, especially for people who cannot study comfortably at home. Students may share small living spaces with relatives, and adults preparing for professional examinations often need extended periods of concentration. A library that becomes noisy throughout its building would lose one of its most distinctive benefits. Soundproof or clearly separated quiet zones should therefore remain part of every major library.

At the same time, collaborative activities can make libraries more useful to a wider community. A digital skills workshop might help older residents learn to use online services, while a language conversation group could support newcomers. These programmes encourage people to share knowledge and may introduce new visitors to the library's books and research resources. They are particularly valuable when commercial courses are too expensive.

The two purposes can coexist through practical design. Libraries could place group rooms near entrances, schedule events away from examination periods and use clear signs to indicate noise expectations. Where budgets permit, movable partitions and acoustic materials can reduce disruption. Staff should consult regular users before changing the layout and monitor whether complaints increase.

In conclusion, libraries should maintain dependable silent study spaces without abandoning their growing role as community learning centres. A balanced floor plan and thoughtful scheduling can protect concentration while making room for interaction.
tips_md: **IELTS Opinion:** Luận điểm là duy trì cả hai chức năng với ưu tiên không gian yên tĩnh. Phát triển ví dụ người học, hoạt động cộng đồng và giải pháp thiết kế cụ thể.

title: VSTEP – Hỏi thông tin khảo sát chim
prompt:
You saw an announcement about a weekend bird survey in a local wetland. Write an email to the environmental club asking where and when the group will meet, whether beginners are welcome, what equipment you should bring and whether there is a participation fee. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết email hỏi thông tin lịch trình và điều kiện tham gia, dùng giọng lịch sự.
sample_answer:
Dear Environmental Club Team,

I recently saw your announcement about the weekend bird survey at the local wetland, and I would be interested in taking part. I enjoy spending time outdoors, although I have never joined a formal wildlife survey before.

Could you please tell me the exact meeting point and what time the group is expected to finish? I will be travelling by bus, so directions from the nearest stop would be particularly helpful.

I would also like to know whether beginners can participate without any previous birdwatching experience. Should I bring binoculars and a notebook, or will the club provide basic equipment? Finally, please let me know whether there is a registration or participation fee.

Thank you for organising an activity that helps people learn about local wildlife. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
Thao Nguyen
tips_md: **VSTEP Email – Request:** Gom câu hỏi về thời gian, người mới, thiết bị và lệ phí. Dùng *Could you please tell me...* và *I would also like to know whether...* để tránh hỏi trực tiếp thiếu lịch sự.

title: VSTEP – Thông báo nhu cầu ăn uống cho gia đình chủ nhà
prompt:
You will stay with a host family during a short language programme. Write an email introducing yourself, explaining that you do not eat seafood, offering to help with meals and asking about the family's usual dinner time. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Giới thiệu, nêu nhu cầu ăn uống nhã nhặn, đề nghị giúp việc bếp và hỏi giờ ăn.
sample_answer:
Dear Mrs. Wilson,

My name is Quynh, and I will be staying with your family during the three-week language programme next month. I am excited to meet everyone and learn more about daily life in your city.

Before I arrive, I would like to mention one dietary preference. I do not eat seafood, but I enjoy vegetables, rice, chicken and most other foods. Please do not feel that you need to prepare special dishes for me. I am happy to make simple meals when necessary, and I would love to help set the table or wash the dishes.

Could you tell me what time your family usually has dinner? My afternoon classes end at five, so knowing your routine will help me plan my journey home.

Thank you very much for welcoming me. I look forward to meeting you soon.

Best wishes,
Quynh
tips_md: **VSTEP Email – Host Family:** Thể hiện nhu cầu cá nhân không áp đặt người nhận. Phân biệt *I do not eat seafood* với tuyên bố dị ứng nếu đề không nói. Kết thư thân thiện vừa phải.

title: VSTEP – Xin lỗi vì làm hỏng máy ảnh mượn
prompt:
You borrowed a camera from your friend Ben for a school project. You accidentally damaged the battery cover. Write a personal email explaining what happened, apologising, proposing a way to repair or replace the part, and suggesting when you can return the camera. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu sự việc trung thực, nhận trách nhiệm và đề xuất khắc phục rõ ràng.
sample_answer:
Hi Ben,

I am writing because something happened to the camera you kindly lent me for my photography project. Yesterday afternoon, I was putting it back into its case when the battery cover caught on the strap. The small plastic clip broke, although the camera itself still turns on and takes pictures normally.

I am really sorry for the damage. I should have checked that the strap was clear before closing the case. I have found a local camera repair shop that can replace the cover, and I would like to pay for the repair. I will ask them for a written estimate before agreeing to any work.

Would it be all right if I returned the camera next Saturday after the repair? If you need it sooner, I can bring it over tomorrow and discuss the options with you.

Thanks for understanding,
Trang
tips_md: **VSTEP Apology:** Nêu trình tự sự việc, phần hư hỏng cụ thể và cách bồi hoàn. Dùng *I should have checked...* để nhận trách nhiệm; hỏi ý kiến chủ sở hữu trước khi sửa.

title: VSTEP – Mời chuyên gia nói chuyện về tái chế
prompt:
You are organising a school environmental club meeting. Write a polite invitation email to a local recycling specialist. Explain the aim of the meeting, suggest a date and a 30-minute presentation, ask whether the specialist can bring examples and offer to answer questions about the venue. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Có lời mời rõ, thời lượng, đề tài và yêu cầu hỗ trợ cụ thể.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Parker,

I am a member of the Green Steps Club at Westbrook Secondary School. Our club is planning an environmental awareness meeting for students who would like to reduce waste at home and at school.

We would be delighted if you could give a 30-minute presentation on practical recycling methods. The meeting is scheduled for Friday, 16 April, at 3:30 p.m. in our school hall, but we can consider a different time if necessary.

Students are particularly interested in learning how to identify recyclable packaging and avoid common sorting mistakes. If convenient, could you bring a few clean examples of materials that can and cannot be recycled? We can provide a projector, a microphone and a table for your demonstration.

Please let me know whether you are available. I would be happy to answer any questions about the venue or the audience.

Yours sincerely,
An Le
Green Steps Club
tips_md: **VSTEP Invitation:** Trình bày *purpose – date/time – request – support – closing*. Dùng *We would be delighted if...* và *If convenient...* để mời trang trọng mà không gây áp lực.

title: VSTEP – Xin đổi lịch kiểm tra năng lực tiếng Anh
prompt:
You registered for a language centre's English proficiency test next month, but a compulsory university field trip now falls on the same day. Write an email requesting an alternative test date, explaining the conflict, asking about possible fees, and offering to provide evidence. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Xin đổi lịch, nêu lý do xác thực và hỏi quy trình, không giả định được đổi miễn phí.
sample_answer:
Dear Examinations Office,

I registered for the English proficiency test scheduled for 12 May, and my registration number is E2418. Unfortunately, my university has recently arranged a compulsory field trip on the same date, so I will not be able to attend the examination as planned.

I would like to ask whether it is possible to transfer my registration to the next available test session. Could you also explain the steps required to request this change and whether an administration fee applies? I understand that changes may depend on the centre's policy and the number of available places.

If necessary, I can send a letter from my department confirming that the field trip is compulsory. I would be grateful for your guidance so that I can complete any paperwork before the deadline.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,
Duc Pham
tips_md: **VSTEP Formal Request:** Đưa mốc ngày và số đăng ký mẫu để thư rõ ràng. Hỏi *whether a fee applies* thay vì khẳng định trung tâm miễn phí. Sử dụng *transfer my registration* chính xác.

title: VSTEP – Cảm ơn sau đợt thực tập
prompt:
You have completed a four-week internship at a community radio station. Write an email to your supervisor thanking them, describing two useful skills you learned, mentioning a memorable assignment and asking whether you may list the supervisor as a reference in future applications. Write at least 120 words.

Yêu cầu: Viết thư cảm ơn chuyên nghiệp và xin phép sử dụng người giới thiệu.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Harris,

Now that my four-week internship at the community radio station has ended, I would like to thank you for your guidance and patience. I enjoyed working with the production team and appreciated the opportunities to take part in real broadcasts.

During the placement, I learned how to edit short audio clips and write clear interview questions under a deadline. These skills have already helped me become more confident when preparing university assignments. My favourite experience was helping record the neighbourhood history programme. Listening to residents describe changes in their community taught me the importance of careful research and respectful interviews.

I hope to apply for another media internship next summer. Would you be comfortable if I listed you as a professional reference? I would contact you before providing your details to any employer.

Thank you again for a valuable experience.

Kind regards,
Huy Tran
tips_md: **VSTEP Thank-you Email:** Cảm ơn bằng dẫn chứng kỹ năng cụ thể; dùng *Would you be comfortable if...* để xin phép làm người giới thiệu. Không cung cấp thông tin liên hệ của người khác khi chưa được đồng ý.

title: VSTEP – Học qua chuyến đi thực tế
prompt:
Some teachers believe schools should organise more educational field trips, while others think classroom lessons are a better use of limited school time. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: So sánh trải nghiệm thực tế với hiệu quả tổ chức lớp học và đưa ra cách kết hợp phù hợp.
sample_answer:
Educational field trips allow students to learn outside their usual classrooms, but organising them takes time and money. Some teachers believe these experiences are essential, while others prefer to concentrate on regular lessons. In my opinion, schools should include carefully planned field trips as part of their programmes without allowing them to replace necessary classroom study.

Supporters of field trips point out that real experiences make abstract subjects easier to understand. For example, students studying local history can visit an old railway station and examine photographs, tools and buildings from the past. They can ask questions that arise naturally from what they see. A science visit to a water treatment facility may also show how concepts taught in textbooks are applied to everyday problems. These experiences can improve curiosity and help students remember information.

However, classroom learning has significant advantages. Teachers can guide activities in a controlled environment, monitor progress and ensure that everyone receives the same essential explanations. Field trips also require transport, permission and supervision. If families must pay substantial fees, some children may be unable to participate, which would create an unfair situation.

I believe schools can combine both approaches effectively. Teachers should first introduce the key ideas in class, then choose visits that support clear learning objectives. After each trip, students might write reflections or create short presentations. Financial assistance and free local destinations could make participation more equal.

To conclude, regular lessons provide the structure that students need, while field trips give that knowledge a practical context. A balanced programme offers the greatest educational value.
tips_md: **VSTEP Discuss Both Views:** Nêu dẫn chứng môn lịch sử và khoa học, sau đó đối chiếu chi phí và tổ chức. Ý kiến cá nhân nên đề xuất trình tự *before – during – after* chuyến đi.

title: VSTEP – Ứng dụng nhắc lịch sinh hoạt
prompt:
Mobile applications can remind people to drink water, take exercise breaks and attend medical appointments. Do these reminders help people develop good habits, or do they make people too dependent on technology? Discuss and give your view. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích tác dụng tạo thói quen, giới hạn của thông báo và quyền tự chủ cá nhân.
sample_answer:
Mobile applications can send reminders for everyday activities, from drinking water to attending scheduled appointments. Some people welcome this support, while others worry that frequent notifications encourage dependence. I believe reminders can be useful when people choose them carefully and learn to manage their routines independently.

One advantage is that reminders reduce the need to remember several small tasks at once. A busy worker may forget to stand up during a long period at a desk, even though short breaks can improve comfort. A simple alert can prompt the person to move before returning to work. Similarly, an appointment reminder may help someone avoid missing an important booking. These features are particularly convenient when schedules change from week to week.

Reminders can also help users observe patterns. By reviewing which activities they complete regularly, people may identify unrealistic goals and adjust them. For example, someone who repeatedly ignores an evening walking reminder might choose a more suitable time in the morning.

Nevertheless, relying on every notification has disadvantages. Constant alerts interrupt concentration, and users may stop paying attention when too many appear. Some applications also encourage people to record more personal information than is necessary for a basic reminder. Good habits should eventually become part of daily life rather than depend entirely on a phone.

In my view, users should begin with a small number of meaningful reminders and review their usefulness after a few weeks. They can gradually reduce notifications for habits that have become automatic.

In conclusion, technology can support personal organisation, but its greatest value comes from helping people build routines that remain practical even without constant alerts.
tips_md: **VSTEP Discussion:** Phân biệt nhắc lịch với tư vấn y tế; ví dụ chỉ mô tả quản lý thói quen thông thường. Đối chiếu lợi ích *consistency* với bất lợi *notification fatigue*.

title: VSTEP – Câu lạc bộ sau giờ học ở thị trấn nhỏ
prompt:
Young people in smaller towns sometimes have fewer organised activities after school than those in large cities. What problems can this cause, and what can schools and local communities do to provide more opportunities? Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu vấn đề cơ hội phát triển kỹ năng và giải pháp chia sẻ cơ sở vật chất, tình nguyện viên.
sample_answer:
After-school activities can help young people develop interests and friendships outside their normal lessons. However, students in small towns may have limited access to sports teams, music groups or practical workshops. This can affect their confidence and opportunities to learn, so schools and local communities should cooperate to create more affordable activities.

One problem is the narrow range of experiences available. If students cannot try different hobbies, they may struggle to discover talents that are not assessed in ordinary examinations. A teenager interested in photography, for instance, might have nobody nearby who can teach basic techniques. Limited activities may also leave students with fewer chances to work in teams and meet people from other classes.

Another difficulty is unequal access. Families with money and transport can travel to larger towns for lessons, but others cannot. As a result, some students may miss opportunities simply because of where they live.

A practical solution is to use buildings that already exist. Schools could open classrooms or sports courts for supervised clubs on certain afternoons. Local artists, university students and retired professionals might volunteer to lead short courses. A monthly schedule of rotating activities would allow students to sample different interests without requiring a permanent specialist teacher for every subject.

Communities could also organise shared transport between nearby schools for larger events. Small participation fees, with exemptions for families who need support, could help pay for equipment.

Overall, after-school opportunities are important for personal development. Cooperation and careful use of local resources can make a wider range of activities available to young people in small towns.
tips_md: **VSTEP Problems–Solutions:** Nêu rõ thiếu hoạt động gây mất cơ hội khám phá sở thích và bất bình đẳng tiếp cận. Biện pháp cần khả thi với ngân sách thị trấn nhỏ.

title: VSTEP – Phố đi bộ cuối tuần
prompt:
A town council plans to close one central street to private cars every Sunday so that people can walk, shop and attend small outdoor events. Do you support this proposal? Consider residents, businesses and transport arrangements. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng, lợi ích kinh tế – cộng đồng và điều kiện tổ chức giao thông.
sample_answer:
Many towns are looking for ways to make their centres more pleasant and attractive to visitors. Closing one central street to private cars on Sundays could create a useful public space for walking, shopping and cultural events. I support the proposal, provided that the council makes practical arrangements for residents and deliveries.

The most immediate benefit would be a more comfortable environment for pedestrians. Families could walk safely between shops without worrying about heavy traffic. Small businesses might place stalls outside, and local musicians could perform in a shared public area. These activities could encourage residents to spend time in the town centre rather than travelling elsewhere for entertainment.

A Sunday street market could also create opportunities for independent sellers. Farmers, craftspeople and small cafés might reach customers who do not normally visit their premises. If the council promotes the events consistently, the street could develop a strong local identity.

However, temporary road closures can inconvenience people who live or work nearby. Residents may need access to their homes, while shops require deliveries and waste collection. The council should therefore publish clear diversion routes and allow essential vehicles to enter at agreed times. Nearby parking and bus stops should be well signposted, especially for visitors with mobility difficulties.

I would suggest starting with a three-month trial. The council could survey residents and traders, measure foot traffic and record complaints before deciding whether to continue.

In conclusion, a weekly pedestrian street could strengthen community life and support local businesses. Its success would depend on good consultation and transport planning rather than simply closing the road.
tips_md: **VSTEP Opinion:** Có lập trường ủng hộ có điều kiện. Nêu lợi ích người đi bộ và tiểu thương, sau đó xử lý giao hàng và tiếp cận của cư dân bằng giải pháp thử nghiệm.

title: VSTEP – Thực tập có trả lương
prompt:
Some employers offer unpaid internships to students, arguing that professional experience is valuable compensation. Others believe all internships should be paid. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích giá trị kinh nghiệm, cơ hội bình đẳng và yêu cầu trả công tương xứng.
sample_answer:
Internships often provide students with their first experience of professional life. Some employers argue that training and workplace exposure are enough compensation, while others believe interns should always receive payment. I agree that genuine work deserves fair financial support, although educational placements may require flexible arrangements.

Unpaid internships can sometimes offer real learning opportunities. A student who spends a short period observing meetings, asking questions and receiving guidance may gain insights that are difficult to obtain from textbooks. Small charities and community organisations may also lack the budget to pay every visitor who participates in a brief learning programme. In such cases, the educational purpose should be clearly explained before a placement begins.

However, unpaid work can create unfair barriers. Students who must earn money for food or accommodation may be unable to accept a full-time placement without wages. This means that valuable opportunities can become concentrated among families with greater financial resources. Employers may also be tempted to assign routine tasks to interns who receive little training. When a student produces work that directly benefits an organisation, there is a strong argument for payment.

In my view, employers should pay interns who perform regular duties and contribute to daily operations. Universities and organisations could agree on minimum learning standards, named supervisors and written schedules. Short observation visits might be handled differently, but transport or meal support should still be considered where possible.

In conclusion, professional experience is valuable, yet it should not depend on a student's ability to work without income. Transparent learning objectives and fair compensation can make internships both educational and accessible.
tips_md: **VSTEP Discuss Both Views:** Phân biệt *job shadowing* ngắn hạn và công việc thực tế tạo giá trị. Quan điểm tập trung công bằng cơ hội và nguyên tắc trả công.

title: VSTEP – Chấm điểm thuyết trình nhóm
prompt:
University students are often required to deliver group presentations. Some think every group member should receive the same mark, while others support individual marks based on contribution. Discuss both approaches and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: So sánh đánh giá kết quả chung và công sức từng thành viên, đề xuất tiêu chí chấm công bằng.
sample_answer:
Group presentations are widely used at universities because they help students practise communication and teamwork. However, teachers face a difficult decision when grading them. Some believe all members should receive the same mark for a shared result, while others prefer to assess individual contributions. I support a combination of group and individual marks.

A single group mark can encourage students to cooperate. If everyone is responsible for the final presentation, members have a reason to help one another improve weak slides or rehearse difficult sections. The approach also reflects many workplaces, where teams are judged by the quality of a completed project rather than by every small task performed separately.

Nevertheless, equal marks may be unfair when contributions differ greatly. One student might research the topic, design the slides and rehearse repeatedly, while another does very little preparation. Awarding the same grade to both could reduce motivation and create conflict within the team. Individual assessment can recognise effort and discourage students from depending on others.

The challenge is to evaluate contributions accurately. Teachers may not observe the preparation process, and peer reviews can be influenced by friendships. A fair system could allocate part of the grade to the overall presentation and part to individual speaking, research notes and a short reflection on assigned responsibilities. Students should know the criteria before they begin and have a chance to report problems early.

In conclusion, group presentations should reward both collaboration and personal accountability. Combining shared and individual marks offers a more balanced way to recognise what students have achieved together and separately.
tips_md: **VSTEP Balanced Opinion:** Phân tích mặt công bằng của từng cách chấm. Nêu tiêu chí kết hợp *group outcome*, *individual delivery* và nhật ký công việc để tránh đánh giá tùy tiện.

title: THPT – Ngày trao đổi sách giáo khoa
prompt:
Your school is considering a yearly event where students can exchange used textbooks and exercise books that still have blank pages. Write a 150–180-word opinion essay explaining whether the school should organise this event. Include two benefits and one practical suggestion.

Yêu cầu: Nêu quan điểm, hai lợi ích, một giải pháp tổ chức; dùng từ vựng phù hợp học sinh THPT.
sample_answer:
I think our school should organise a used-book exchange at the end of every school year. This event could help students save money and encourage everyone to use learning materials more responsibly.

First, textbooks are often expensive for families with several children. If students pass on books that are still in good condition, younger learners can prepare for the next grade without buying every title again. Second, an exchange would reduce unnecessary waste. Many books are stored in cupboards after examinations, even though another student could read them.

To make the event successful, the student council could collect books during the final week of term. Volunteers would check that the pages are complete and put the books into clearly labelled boxes for each grade. Students could then exchange a book for another title they need. Any remaining materials might be donated to a local learning centre.

Overall, a book exchange would be a simple and meaningful school activity. It would support families, protect resources and teach students the value of sharing.
tips_md: **THPT Opinion Essay:** Bố cục mở bài nêu đồng ý, thân bài có *First* và *Second*, đoạn cuối đề xuất cách thực hiện. Dùng *in good condition*, *clearly labelled*, *donate* cho chủ đề sách cũ.

title: THPT – Kỹ năng quản lý tiền tiêu vặt
prompt:
Some students believe schools should teach basic personal finance, such as saving money and planning a monthly budget. Write a 150–180-word essay stating your opinion and giving examples relevant to teenagers.

Yêu cầu: Đưa ý kiến và hai ví dụ gần gũi, tránh khuyến khích đầu tư rủi ro.
sample_answer:
I believe basic personal finance should be taught in secondary schools because students already make small financial decisions in everyday life. Learning to manage money early can help them become more responsible adults.

One useful lesson would be preparing a simple budget. For example, a student who receives a monthly allowance could divide it into transport, school supplies, snacks and savings. This would make it easier to notice unnecessary spending and plan for a larger purchase, such as a dictionary or a bicycle helmet.

Another important skill is comparing prices. Teenagers often see special offers online, but a discount does not always mean that an item is affordable or necessary. Teachers could ask students to compare the total costs of several products, including delivery fees, before choosing one.

Schools do not need an expensive course to cover these topics. Short practical activities in mathematics or life-skills lessons would be enough to introduce the basic ideas.

In conclusion, teaching saving and budgeting would prepare teenagers for real decisions. These skills are useful both at school and later in life.
tips_md: **THPT Essay:** Chọn ví dụ học sinh như tiền tiêu vặt, đi lại và mua đồ dùng. Thân bài phân tích *budget* và *compare prices*, kết luận không mở ý mới.

title: THPT – Góc cây xanh trong lớp học
prompt:
Your school plans to let each class grow a small collection of plants near its windows. Write a 150–180-word essay on whether this is a good idea. Discuss educational value and how students could maintain the plants during holidays.

Yêu cầu: Trình bày ý kiến, lợi ích học tập và giải pháp chăm cây có trách nhiệm.
sample_answer:
I support the idea of creating a small plant corner in every classroom. Looking after plants could make the learning environment more pleasant and give students a chance to practise responsibility.

Plants can also make lessons more interesting. In biology, for instance, we could observe changes in leaves and record how quickly different seeds grow. Students who do not study science might enjoy watching a tiny seedling develop over several weeks. Working together to care for the plants would also encourage cooperation.

However, a classroom garden needs a realistic maintenance plan. Some plants require frequent watering, especially during hot weather. Each class could choose hardy varieties and create a weekly duty schedule. Before long holidays, students should ask a teacher to arrange a safe place for the plants or assign volunteers who are visiting the school.

The project should remain small enough for everyone to manage without spending much money.

In my opinion, a few healthy plants would be better than an impressive display that nobody can maintain. With a clear plan, the activity could be both enjoyable and educational.
tips_md: **THPT Opinion:** Tránh liệt kê quá nhiều cây. Nêu cách chăm sóc ngày thường và ngày nghỉ, dùng *duty schedule*, *hardy plants*, *responsibility* đúng ngữ cảnh.

title: THPT – Tham gia biểu diễn văn hóa ở trường
prompt:
Some students enjoy performing music or drama during school cultural festivals, while others prefer helping with planning, lighting or welcoming guests. Write a 150–180-word essay explaining why both kinds of participation are valuable.
