Yêu cầu: So sánh vai trò trước sân khấu và hậu trường, có ví dụ và kết luận khích lệ.
sample_answer:
School cultural festivals are more successful when students can contribute in different ways. I believe performers and behind-the-scenes volunteers are equally important because each group has a special role in creating a good event.

Students who sing, dance or act share their talents with an audience. Preparing for a performance can help them become more confident and learn to work with others. For example, a drama group must practise timing and listen carefully to every member before appearing on stage.

Behind-the-scenes volunteers develop different but equally useful skills. They may prepare chairs, create a schedule, check microphones or welcome guests at the entrance. These tasks require organisation and careful communication. Without reliable volunteers, even excellent performers might struggle to begin on time.

Schools should recognise both groups during the festival and give students a chance to choose tasks that match their interests. A quiet student who dislikes performing might discover a talent for event planning.

In conclusion, a festival belongs to everyone who helps make it happen. Valuing different contributions encourages more students to participate and strengthens the school community.
tips_md: **THPT Discussion:** Mỗi đoạn thân bài có một nhóm vai trò và ví dụ. Dùng *behind-the-scenes volunteers*, *event planning* để nói công việc hậu trường; tránh chê những bạn không biểu diễn.

title: IT Workplace – Thông báo chuyển phiên bản API
prompt:
Write an internal memo of 120–160 words to the engineering and analytics teams. Your company will retire the fictional /v1/reports API on 15 December 2026 and replace it with /v2/reports. Ask teams to finish migration by 8 December, name an owner for compatibility testing, explain where failures should be reported, and state that the old endpoint remains available until retirement. Use To, From, Date, and Subject headers.

Yêu cầu: Viết memo có ngày chuyển đổi, hành động, người phụ trách và đường xử lý sự cố.
sample_answer:
To: Engineering and Analytics Teams
From: Hana Tran, Platform Lead
Date: 24 November 2026
Subject: Migration to the reports API v2

The current /v1/reports endpoint will be retired on 15 December 2026. All applications and scheduled reports must use /v2/reports after that date.

Please complete your migration by 8 December and update any automated jobs that call the older endpoint. The /v1/reports service will remain available until its retirement date, allowing both versions to be checked during the transition.

Hana Tran will coordinate compatibility testing with the analytics team. Each application owner should run a sample report, verify the returned fields and record any differences in the internal issue tracker under the API Migration project. Include the affected application, request time and expected result.

We will review outstanding issues on 9 December and confirm readiness before retiring the endpoint. Thank you for helping keep reporting reliable.
tips_md: **IT Memo – API Migration:** Đọc kỹ hai hạn *8 December* và *15 December*. Thông báo rõ người chịu trách nhiệm, hành động của từng nhóm và nơi báo lỗi; dùng câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự như *Please complete...*.

title: IT Workplace – Thông báo bảo trì cơ sở dữ liệu
prompt:
Draft a 120–170-word internal maintenance memo for department managers. A fictional reporting database will undergo scheduled maintenance on 6 December 2026 from 1:00 to 1:30 a.m. local time. During this period, the analytics dashboard may be read-only. State the backup verification step, expected user impact, contact path and contingency if maintenance takes longer. Include memo headers.

Yêu cầu: Nêu thời gian chính xác, giới hạn dịch vụ, kiểm tra sao lưu và quy trình cập nhật khi kéo dài.
sample_answer:
To: Department Managers
From: Marcus Le, Database Operations
Date: 24 November 2026
Subject: Reporting database maintenance on 6 December

The reporting database is scheduled for maintenance on Sunday, 6 December 2026, from 1:00 to 1:30 a.m. local time. During the window, the analytics dashboard may operate in read-only mode, and new reports could be delayed.

The database team will verify the latest backup and confirm its recovery status before maintenance begins. We will also record service health checks before and after the work. Users should avoid scheduling important report exports during this interval.

If your department notices an issue afterward, please contact the IT service desk and include the report name and the approximate time of the problem. If work cannot be completed by 1:30 a.m., we will stop the change, assess whether a rollback is required and send an updated notice to managers.

A completion message will follow once normal dashboard operations are confirmed.
tips_md: **IT Memo – Maintenance:** Phân biệt khoảng thời gian bảo trì và thời gian gửi báo cáo hoàn tất. Dùng *read-only mode*, *backup verification*, *rollback* chính xác; không khẳng định đã sao lưu nếu bước kiểm tra mới được lên kế hoạch.

title: IT Workplace – Kết quả diễn tập nhận diện email giả mạo
prompt:
Write a 120–170-word internal memo after a fictional security-awareness exercise. During a simulated phishing email test, 18 of 60 staff members clicked the training link, and 7 requested verification through the approved security channel. No passwords or real account data were collected. Explain the figures accurately, announce a 20-minute refresher session next week, and tell staff how to report suspicious emails. Include memo headers and a constructive tone.

Yêu cầu: Báo cáo số liệu đúng, tránh đổ lỗi cá nhân và chỉ dẫn cách báo email khả nghi.
sample_answer:
To: All Staff
From: Aisha Nguyen, Information Security
Date: 24 November 2026
Subject: Email awareness exercise and next steps

Last week's simulated email exercise has concluded. Of the 60 employees who received the message, 18 clicked the training link, while seven contacted the approved security channel to verify the email. The exercise was designed for learning, and no passwords or real account information were collected.

The results show that we need more practice recognising unexpected requests. Next Wednesday, the security team will host a 20-minute refresher on checking sender details, reviewing links and confirming unusual instructions through a known contact method.

If you receive a suspicious email, use the Report Suspicious Message option in the company mail application or contact the security desk directly. Avoid forwarding the message to colleagues, and wait for guidance before interacting with its contents.

Thank you to everyone who participated. We will share a short reference sheet after the session.
tips_md: **IT Memo – Awareness:** Số liệu *18/60* là người nhấp liên kết, *7* là số người xác minh; không tự diễn giải 7 người ấy thuộc nhóm đã nhấp. Giữ văn phong hỗ trợ, cung cấp kênh báo cáo rõ.

title: IT Workplace – Đề xuất hoãn phát hành phần mềm
prompt:
Write a 130–180-word internal decision memo for the product director. A fictional dashboard release is scheduled for 27 November 2026 at 4:00 p.m. The team has passed 18 smoke tests, but a high-severity defect causes some CSV exports to omit the final data row. Recommend a go/no-go decision, state the risk, assign remediation and retesting, and propose when to review the decision again. Use memo headers.

Yêu cầu: Báo cáo bằng chứng đã kiểm thử, chỉ rõ tác động lỗi và điều kiện phê duyệt phát hành.
sample_answer:
To: Product Director
From: Linh Pham, Release Coordinator
Date: 24 November 2026
Subject: No-go recommendation for dashboard release

I recommend postponing the dashboard release currently scheduled for 4:00 p.m. on 27 November. Although all 18 smoke tests passed, final review identified a high-severity defect in CSV exports. Under some conditions, the downloaded file omits the last data row. Publishing the release now could cause customers to make decisions using incomplete reports.

The export module owner will investigate and correct the defect, then add a regression check covering the final-row case. Quality assurance will rerun the export scenarios and the full smoke-test suite after the fix. The release coordinator will also confirm that customer-facing sample reports match the source data.

I propose a readiness review at 10:00 a.m. on 27 November. We should approve deployment only when the export defect is resolved, the regression checks pass and the team signs off on the results. If any condition remains open, we will propose a new release date.
tips_md: **IT Memo – Go/No-Go:** Trình bày quyết định trước rồi đến rủi ro và điều kiện phát hành. Không dùng 18 bài smoke test đạt để bỏ qua lỗi nghiêm trọng. Nêu chính xác người sửa, người kiểm thử và lịch đánh giá lại.
